In the beginning phase of treatment, what would a Bowen Family Systems therapist do?

options.A: Create a family diagram of multigenerational emotional connections, genogram
options.B: Assess communication patterns, stances, and concerns.
options.C: Establish rapport, a sense of equality and hope

questions.stem: In the beginning phase of treatment, what would a Bowen Family Systems therapist do?

options.A: Assess individuals’ levels of differentiation and triangulation
options.B: assess family’s destructive patterns of relating and communicating the continued problem
options.D: Establish rapport, a sense of equality and hope

questions.stem: In the middle phase of treatment, what would a Bowen Family Systems therapist do?

options.A: Teach and model differentiation through communication skill building, I-statements, teaching differences between thoughts and feelings, as well as differentiate their feelings from other people.
options.B: Support and strengthen each individual’s sense of uniqueness and self-esteem.
options.C: utilize enactments of issues to challenge participants and unbalance the system.

questions.stem: In the middle phase of treatment, what would a Bowen Family Systems therapist do?

options.A: De-triangulation, identifying the triangles, and exploring how that has been something that has been passed down. De-pathologizing the individual and looking at it through a family systems lens.
options.B: assign ordeals; prescribe the problem; relabel behavior

questions.stem: In the end phase of treatment, what would a Bowen Family Systems therapist do?

options.B: Review new skills and knowledge gained in therapy.
options.C: Plan for maintenance of new behavior
